recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: eclipse webcams waiting for the moon's shadow
thirty-six hours under rubble, then daylight
ad blockers conceding the endless feed
delphi's thirteenth edition opened for tinkerers
summer fog settling over san francisco at dusk
overcast august evening, thirteen degrees and still

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Hold your finger on a live eclipse feed to track the moon's shadow — release exactly at totality before the webcam buffer glitches.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one perfect release at totality feels like catching a rare celestial moment in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: totality window shrinks each round while clouds drift across the lens
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: grainy webcam footage with CRT scanlines and countdown overlays

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag agent tokens from a phone shortcut tray into parallel build lanes — each lane runs a tiny task that finishes before sunrise.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: watching three agents complete micro-builds simultaneously in 30 seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: new agent types arrive mid-round with conflicting resource slots
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: iOS shortcut tiles over a dark terminal-green glow

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw paths through rolling fog banks to guide stray sunbeams to a pier before the summer sunset fades.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one clean path lights the whole waterfront in a single satisfying sweep
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fog thickens and wind shifts your drawn path mid-stroke
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor fog in muted grey-blue summer tones

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick debris aside with precise taps to open air pockets in a collapsed structure — each flick must not trigger a cascade above.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clearing the last block reveals a pulse of warm rescue light
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: unstable layers settle and dust clouds obscure the next target
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: cross-section paper cutout with amber rescue glow
